title: Sound Imitation · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Sound Imitation · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: The lead chooses a familiar everyday sound that can be made without objects. The lead makes an imitation of that sound without naming it. The others identify the intended sound. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: A timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Sound Imitation, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The others identify the intended sound.
recall.why: The others identify the intended sound.
